title: Write the guessing rules
heading: Write the guessing rules
description: Your turn: replace pass with rules that print “Too low!”, “Too high!”, or “You found it!”. Start with secret = 73. Test guesses 1, 72, 73, 74 and 100. Then change the secret and test again.

scene.label: Python output for the number guessing game.

feedback.initial: Write the rules using if, elif and else. Revisit the previous lesson if you need an example.
feedback.empty: Replace pass with your comparisons and messages.
feedback.success: Check a lower guess, an exact match, and a higher guess. This records practice; it does not grade your answers. Later we can add player input and a hidden random secret.
